question: New Delhi is the headquarters of which railway zone?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Northern railway zone.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Northern railway zone:-**

 
 
• **New Delhi is the headquarters of the Northern railway zone.**
 
• The Northern railway zone is one of the 18 railway zones in India.
 
• The Northern railway zone covers states such as Delhi, Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and parts of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Southern railway zone:-**

 
 
• The Southern railway zone covers states such as Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Puducherry, and parts of Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka.
 
• The Southern railway zone has its headquarters in Chennai.
 
 
 
• **Eastern railway zone:-**
 
 
• The Eastern railway zone has its headquarters in Kolkata.
 
• The Eastern railway zone covers states such as West Bengal, Jharkhand, Bihar, and parts of Odisha.
 
 
 
• **Central railway zone:-**
 
 
• The Central railway zone has its headquarters in Mumbai.
 
• The Central railway zone covers states such as Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and parts of Uttar Pradesh and Karnataka.
